title: 美联储政策路径与美债久期博弈
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let me start with you, Rebecca. What is your confidence that the Fed will be able to stay ahead of inflation? Today's market reaction seems to suggest there's growing optimism. That's the case. Yeah, I think we'd look at how the market responded
segments.zh: 先从Rebecca开始。你对美联储能领先通胀有多大信心？今天的市场反应似乎显示乐观情绪升温。确实如此。我认为要看市场对昨天会议的反应

segments.en: to yesterday's meeting, all the commentary they're in, as giving some confidence in the Fed's credibility, and it's objective to really tame inflation. We'd also look at what the market
segments.zh: 以及所有相关评论，这给了市场一些对美联储可信度的信心，其目标是真正遏制通胀。我们还要看市场

segments.en: has already priced in so far this year. Just take the Bloomberg US aggregate for example.
segments.zh: 今年已经定价了多少。以彭博美国综合指数为例。

segments.en: It's risen the yield about 100 basis points already so far this year, so as we know the bond market tends to do, it prices in a little bit of the pain of tightening policy ahead of time,
segments.zh: 今年迄今收益率已上升约100个基点，正如我们所知，债券市场往往提前定价部分紧缩政策的压力，

segments.en: so we feel pretty confident that we're on a bit of a path of recalibration of policy
segments.zh: 所以我们相当有信心，我们正处于政策重新校准的路径上

segments.en: that can help to tame the inflation picture we're looking at today. Ed, what did you think of Warsha's framing of the hike, tying it to the economy strengthening more than any kind
segments.zh: 这有助于遏制当前的通胀形势。Ed，你怎么看Warsha将加息与经济增长挂钩，而非担忧AI热潮或长期债券收益率飙升？

segments.en: of concern about the AI boom or the surge in lung bond yields? Yeah, I think that was the right way to position it. You know, the big change in the underlying story this year in the US has been
segments.zh: 我认为这是正确的定位。今年美国底层叙事的一大变化是

segments.en: the improvement in the labor market. We've been waiting for that improvement that kind of plates way through the economy. We finally got to a point where the upside risk that poses to inflation
segments.zh: 劳动力市场的改善。我们一直在等待这种改善渗透到整个经济中。我们终于到了这样一个点，即它对通胀构成的上行风险

segments.en: was impossible to ignore, and so we're starting to see that move. I think that's exactly the right framing.
segments.zh: 已不容忽视，所以我们开始看到这种变化。我认为这正是正确的框架。
